about: Owner fills `models` before `report`: USD per million tokens from each provider's official pricing page, read on the date in checked_on. Keys = provider:model exactly as in models.json. OpenRouter calls use the cost OpenRouter itself reports per call (usd_reported) and need no entry. Output tokens include reasoning tokens. No caching or batch discount is assumed. While a price is null, `plan`/`run` show the UPPER BOUND from `fallback`, and `report` shows tokens without $.

fallback.about: CONSERVATIVE UPPER BOUND, NOT AN OFFICIAL PRICE. Deliberately high per-million-token prices, only to show a worst case before the owner fills `models`; the bound also assumes every call uses its full output cap (MAX_TOKENS = 16000). Same convention as HMD-020/021/022.
